welcome: welcome! welcome to hearthmakers! enjoy your stay and have fun! portal news welcome to hearthmakers! thanks for stopping by our portal! hearthmakers is a small personal project we put together as a tribute to one of our favourite games of recent years, stonehearth . the theme follows the same line: a voxel world and building towns and colonies. but we've brought in our own style of play and many mechanics we love from other genres and games. main features: build your own world! called a "realm", every player can have their own. control a pioneer, you in the game! you have an avatar that represents you! visit public "realms" and play with friends! the game is all about being social. it's better with friends! rpg combat and progression! rpg elements for your characters pioneers and colonists . host your own server! have your own server to play with your friends. we believe a home begins with a campfire and a few friends gathered around it... in active development! we're actively developing the project, and we invite everyone interested to join us on this journey. no project is complete without a good community, and we'd love to build our little world together with you!
